description: 味方単体のHPを50％回復するゼリー状の薬。<EN>A jelly-like medicine that restores 50% HP to a single ally.
name: ライフゼリー<EN>Life Jelly
note:
<dPlnText:A medicine that heals wounds. Made by the worldwide
organization, the Aurum Trading Company. As a healing item,
it is now a standard. You could call it an adventurer's
essential.>

description: 味方単体のHPを100％回復するゼリー状の薬。<EN>A jelly-like medicine that restores 100% HP to a single ally.
name: 超ライフゼリー<EN>Super Life Jelly
note:
<dPlnText:A medicine that heals wounds. Made by the worldwide
organization, the Aurum Trading Company. As a healing item,
it has a very great effect. At the same time, its price is
also very high.>

description: 味方単体のSPを50％回復するゼリー状の薬。<EN>A jelly-like medicine that restores 50% SP to a single ally.
name: エナジーゼリー<EN>Energy Jelly
note:
<dPlnText:A medicine that restores energy. Made by the worldwide organization, the
Aurum Trading Company. To unleash techniques and magic, a corresponding
amount of energy is required. This will help with that, but it is expensive
due to the large amount of mana used as material.>

description: 味方単体のSPを100％回復するゼリー状の薬。<EN>A jelly-like medicine that restores 100% SP to a single ally.
name: 超エナジーゼリー<EN>Super Energy Jelly
note:
<dPlnText:A medicine that restores energy. Made by the worldwide
organization, the Aurum Trading Company. As a healing item,
it has a very great effect. At the same time, its price is
also very high.>

description:
味方単体の状態異常を解除するゼリー状の薬。
赤枠の状態異常は解除できない。<EN>A jelly-like medicine that cures status ailments for a single ally. Cannot cure
red-framed status ailments.
name: ヘルシーゼリー<EN>Health Jelly
note:
<dPlnText:A medicine that treats physical abnormalities. Made by the
worldwide organization, the Aurum Trading Company. This
cures only status ailments. It does not heal wounds, nor
does it have the power to recover one's stance.>

description: 味方単体の能力値DOWNを解除するゼリー状の薬。<EN>A jelly-like medicine that removes stat DOWN effects from a single ally.
name: パワーゼリー<EN>Power Jelly
note:
<dPlnText:A medicine that treats physical abnormalities. Made by the
worldwide organization, the Aurum Trading Company. This
cures only ability score reductions. It does not heal
wounds, nor does it have the power to recover one's stance.>

description: 味方単体を復活させHPを25％回復するマナを宿した液体。<EN>A liquid imbued with mana that revives a single ally and restores 25% HP.
name: マナポット<EN>Mana Pot
note:
<dPlnText:A liquid that revives those who are unable to fight. Made by the worldwide
organization, the Aurum Trading Company. The unable-to-fight state and
death are completely different. The former refers, as the name implies, to
a state where one cannot continue fighting.>

description: 味方単体を復活させHPを100％回復するマナを宿した液体。<EN>A liquid imbued with mana that revives a single ally and restores 100% HP.
name: 超マナポット<EN>Super Mana Pot
note:
<dPlnText:A liquid that revives those who are unable to fight. Made by
the worldwide organization, the Aurum Trading Company. The
unable-to-fight state and death are completely different. No
medicine exists that can overturn the latter.>

description: 味方単体のHPとSPを100％回復する薬。<EN>A medicine that fully restores HP and SP of a single ally.
name: アルティメイト<EN>Ultimate
note:
<dPlnText:A special medicine crafted by a top-tier alchemist. It is
not something you can easily obtain. You should use it when
it really counts.>

description: 味方全体のHPとSPを100％回復する薬。<EN>A medicine that fully restores HP and SP of all allies.
name: 超アルティメイト<EN>Super Ultimate
note:
<dPlnText:A special medicine crafted by a top-tier alchemist. It is
not something you can easily obtain. Even when it really
counts, you'd hesitate to use it.>

description: 味方単体のレベルを1上昇させる不思議な種。<EN>A mysterious seed that raises a single ally's level by 1.
name: 鮮烈なマナの種<EN>Vivid Mana Seed
note:
<ExpIncrease:1000000>
<levelUpStop>
<dPlnText:Something that holds astonishing growth potential. This is one form of
mana, and it is called a seed due to its appearance. The power to promote
growth could be said to be the essence of mana. A world that lacks it is
fated to perish.>

description: 味方単体のすべての能力値を5上昇させる果実。<EN>A fruit that raises all stats of a single ally by 5.
name: 成長の果実<EN>Growth Fruit
note:
<dPlnText:Eating it improves your body's basic abilities. This is a
fruit of mana. Consuming it increases your strength as a
living being. It tastes absolutely awful.>

description: 敵単体に約500の波動属性魔法ダメージを与える爆弾。<EN>A bomb that deals about 500 wave-attribute magic damage to a single enemy.
name: 波動爆弾<EN>Wave Bomb
note:
<dPlnText:A bomb imbued with wave magic. The wave attribute is the
power of mana itself. Therefore, it works against most
opponents, but it cannot ignore magical resistance.>

description:
敵全体の強化効果を打ち消す爆弾。
赤枠の強化効果は解除できない。<EN>A bomb that nullifies the buffs of all enemies.
Buffs with red frames cannot be removed.
name: 糞爆弾<EN>Shit Bomb
note:
<dPlnText:A bomb made from hardened shit. Excrement has the effect of
hindering the power of mana. Through this action, it cancels out any
enhancements on those drenched in it. Handle with care. If it goes off
accidentally, it won't end well.>

description: 愛する者に捧げる指輪。<EN>A ring dedicated to a loved one.
name: 契りの輪<EN>Vow Ring
note:
<OrderId:120>
<dPlnText:Something to give to someone. This pledges eternal love. A
timeless vow with one person alone.>

description: 花を紙に押して作られた飾り。<EN>An ornament made by pressing flowers onto paper.
name: 桜の押し花<EN>Pressed Cherry Blossom
note:
<OrderId:120>
<dPlnText:Something to give to someone. A stylish ornament. Cherry
blossoms are beautiful and rarely disliked. It will likely
please anyone.>

description: 狐を模した木彫りの人形。<EN>A wooden figurine modeled after a fox.
name: 狐人形<EN>Fox Doll
note:
<OrderId:120>
<dPlnText:Something to give to someone. A simple doll. Made by who
knows where, it is very endearing. It would make a nice
decorative piece.>

description: 創作意欲を刺激する玩具。<EN>A toy that stimulates creative desire.
name: からくり玩具<EN>Mechanical Toy
note:
<OrderId:120>
<dPlnText:Something to give to someone. A toy to enjoy combining
pieces. It requires a certain amount of aptitude, and some
people cannot grasp its true appeal.>

description: 都の名店、とらやの土産物。<EN>A souvenir from Toraya, a famous shop in the capital.
name: とらや饅頭<EN>Sweet Bun
note:
<OrderId:120>
<dPlnText:Something to give to someone. A famous confectionery of
Shikinowa. One of the standard souvenirs from the eastern
country, not merely sweet, but with a profound flavor to
enjoy.>

description: 神をも酔わせ化かすという酒。<EN>A sake said to intoxicate and even trick gods.
name: 冠化かし<EN>Crown Confection
note:
<OrderId:120>
<dPlnText:Something to give to someone. A liquor made on a remote
island of the eastern country. Quite strong, meant to be
diluted with water or the like. Only monsters can enjoy it
straight.>

description: 冒険者ギルドが発行する読み物。<EN>A publication issued by the Adventurers' Guild.
name: 冒険者通信<EN>Adventurer's Newsletter
note:
<OrderId:120>
<dPlnText:Something to give to someone. A publication issued by the
Adventurer's Guild. The information held by adventurers is
compiled into one organization, and by disseminating it,
people acquire common knowledge.>

description: 北方の大国の作家の作品。<EN>A work by an author from a great northern nation.
name: 異国の絵本<EN>Foreign Picture Book
note:
<OrderId:120>
<dPlnText:Something to give to someone. A picture book with a dark
atmosphere. The blue-toned illustrations make the reader
uneasy, but that is what colors the final hope.>

description: 握り固められた糞。<EN>A clump of hardened feces.
name: 握り糞<EN>Dung Ball
note:
<OrderId:120>
<dPlnText:Something to give to someone. This is feces. As a gift, it
is utterly deranged.>

description: 棒状の何か。<EN>Something stick-shaped.
name: 逞しい棒<EN>Sturdy Stick
note:
<OrderId:120>
<dPlnText:Something to give to someone. A replica of a phallus. Used
by women for masturbation. Rarely, men use it too.>

description: 精液を集め留めるための袋状の道具。<EN>A pouch-like tool for collecting and storing semen.
name: 採精用薄膜<EN>Semen Collection Film
note:
<OrderId:120>
<dPlnText:Something to give to someone. A bag-shaped thin membrane. A
tool for collecting and preserving semen, with magical
processing that keeps it fresh for a long period. It seems
it had a different use in the past.>

description: 使用者の姿を写すという道具。<EN>A tool said to reflect the user's appearance.
name: 身写し形代<EN>Body Effigy
note:
<OrderId:120>
<dPlnText:Something to give to someone. A peculiar effigy. A tool that
mirrors the user's appearance, but the duration is short and
the clone is fragile. It would be difficult to use
effectively in battle.>

description: 夜魔が提供する甘い飲み物。<EN>A sweet drink provided by the night demon.
name: 夜伽鬼の甘酒<EN>Yotogi Oni's Sweet Sake
note:
<OrderId:120>
<dPlnText:Something to give to someone. Its flavor is palatable to
humans. The source of its sweetness is night demon bodily
fluid, which has a strong aphrodisiac effect.>

description: 東国の夜魔が宴の折に纏う衣装。<EN>An outfit worn by the night demon of the Eastern land during feasts.
name: 夜伽鬼の舞台衣装<EN>Yotogi Oni's Stage Costume
note:
<OrderId:120>
<dPlnText:Something to give to someone. An outfit that barely conceals
the private parts. At night demon banquets, mana flies
about. Exposing bare skin is for efficiency.>

description: シキノワでは珍しい水着。<EN>A rare swimsuit in Shikinowa.
name: 異国の水着<EN>Foreign Swimsuit
note:
<OrderId:120>
<dPlnText:Something to give to someone. A risque swimsuit. In the
eastern country, entering the sea itself is taboo, so
swimsuits do not exist there.>

description: 過激な内容の本。<EN>A book with risque content.
name: 過激な書籍<EN>Extreme Book
note:
<OrderId:120>
<dPlnText:Something to give to someone. Its contents are notably
flesh-colored. A rare item for men in modern times,
sometimes treated as an antique.>

description: ナズナの下着。<EN>Nazuna's underwear.
name: ナズナのぱんつ<EN>Nazuna's Panties
note:
<OrderId:115>
<dPlnText:An unexpectedly obtained item Nazuna's underwear There may
be various uses for it Let's try it out somewhere secluded>

description: プリムの下着。<EN>Prim's underwear.
name: プリムのぱんつ<EN>Prim's Panties
note:
<OrderId:115>
<dPlnText:An unexpectedly obtained item Prim's underwear There may be
various uses for it Let's try it out somewhere secluded>

description: 桜悳の下着。<EN>Sakura Toku's underwear.
name: 桜悳のぱんつ<EN>Sakura Toku's Panties
note:
<OrderId:115>
<dPlnText:An unexpectedly obtained item Sakura Toku's underwear There
may be various uses for it Let's try it out somewhere
secluded>

description: ウーラの下着。<EN>Ula's underwear.
name: ウーラのぱんつ<EN>Ula's Panties
note:
<OrderId:115>
<dPlnText:An unexpectedly obtained item Ula's underwear There may be
various uses for it Let's try it out somewhere secluded>

description: 杖の下着、もとい水着。<EN>Staff's underwear―or rather, swimsuit.
name: 杖のぱんつ<EN>Staff's Panties
note:
<OrderId:115>
<dPlnText:An unexpectedly obtained item Staff's underwear, or rather
swimsuit There may be various uses for it Let's try it out
somewhere secluded>

description: 存子の下着。<EN>Aruko's underwear.
name: 存子のぱんつ<EN>Aruko's Panties
note:
<OrderId:115>
<dPlnText:An unexpectedly obtained item Aruko's underwear There may
be various uses for it Let's try it out somewhere secluded>

description: 淡雪の下着。<EN>Awayuki's underwear.
name: 淡雪のぱんつ<EN>Awayuki's Panties
note:
<OrderId:115>
<dPlnText:An unexpectedly obtained item Awayuki's underwear There may
be various uses for it Let's try it out somewhere secluded>

description: 夕闇の下着。<EN>Yuuyami's underwear.
name: 夕闇のぱんつ<EN>Yuuyami's Panties
note:
<OrderId:115>
<dPlnText:An unexpectedly obtained item Yuuyami's underwear There may
be various uses for it Let's try it out somewhere secluded>

description: かつて東国で使用されていた貨幣。<EN>Currency once used in the eastern nation.
name: シキノワ古銭<EN>Shikinowa Old Coin
note:
<dPlnText:シキノワの古い貨幣
現代では使用されていない
　
かつての乱世、怪異が生み出したもので
その一枚一枚に幽かな魂を宿すという><EN><dPlnText:Old currency of Shikinowa
Not in use in modern times
　
Created by Kaii during the turbulent times of the past,
it is said that a faint soul dwells within each and every coin>

description: ラムルアラムで見られる謎の物体。<EN>A mysterious object found in Ramla Aram.
name: 調和トークン<EN>Harmony Token
note:
<dPlnText:An object lying around in Ramla Aram Its use is unclear Two
humans are depicted praising the sun That picture is drawn
on both of them>

description: 丸いどんぐり。一般的に、価値はない。<EN>A round acorn. Generally worthless.
name: どんぐり<EN>Acorn
note:
<dPlnText:An inedible acorn Normally, it has no use The Yori
are convinced That this is the supreme currency>

description:
\C[17]真白神社\C[0]に移動する。
移動中に\C[17]Ｃキー\C[0]を入力すると直接使用できる。<EN>\C[17]Move to Mashiro Shrine.\C[0] Press \C[17]C Key\C[0] during movement to use directly.
name: 帰郷の石<EN>Stone of Return
note:
<dPlnText:A pebble that allows travel to one's homeland Made by the
global organization, Aurum Trading Company Many swear that
they will return home only when their journey ends Yet even
so, this stone will serve as a guide>

description:
イベント画面を表示する。
移動中に\C[17]Ｄキー\C[0]を入力すると直接使用できる。<EN>Display the event screen. Press \C[17]D Key\C[0] during movement to use directly.
name: 冒険者の手記<EN>Adventurer's Memoir
note:
<dPlnText:A journal carried by every adventurer Recording everything
of past journeys and those to come Some travel without a
journal But they are called wanderers, not adventurers>

description:
味方全体のHPを50％回復させる。残り使用可能回数 \C[24]\V[21]\C[0] 回。
移動中に\C[17]Ｖキー\C[0]を入力すると直接使用できる。<EN>Restores 50% HP to all allies. Remaining uses: \C[24]\V[21]\C[0]. Press \C[17]V Key\C[0] during movement to
use directly.
name: マナの水瓶<EN>Mana Vial
note:
<dPlnText:A magical bottle filled with water containing mana A tool
originating from the valley nation of Arzet It's been talked
about as something useful for adventures But for now, it's
not yet widely available>

description: 経験値を獲得するかどうか選択できる。<EN>Choose whether to gain EXP.
name: 挑戦者の鏡<EN>Challenger's Mirror
note:
<dPlnText:A hand mirror holding a strange ability It temporarily
denies the battle experience of the one reflected Efforts
that yield nothing must be futile Yet there are oddballs who
choose to walk that path anyway>

description: 戦闘中に使用すると敗北する。<EN>Using this in battle results in defeat.
name: 敗者の印<EN>Mark of the Defeated
note:
<dPlnText:A curse of those who cannot defeat anyone It lures the user
and their allies to defeat This is a trap, not something to
be used willingly But perhaps there is something to be
gained only through loss>

description: 周囲を照らす魔法道具。<EN>A magical tool that illuminates the surroundings.
name: ミリエマの光<EN>Light of Miriem
note:
<dPlnText:A tool that lights a special flame Indispensable in dark
places Some adventurers fumble their way through poor
visibility But the more seasoned never underestimate the
darkness>

description:
マナの水瓶の使用可能回数が所持数分増加する。<EN>Increases the number of available uses of the Mana Vessel by the amount in your
possession.
name: 生命瓶<EN>Life Bottle
note:
<dPlnText:A special small vial for storing mana A meager amount, but
it can supplement a waterskin Life bottles are common tools
that everyone has But this one is slightly different from
the general standard>

description: 命刻山の湧き水。<EN>Spring water from Mt. Meikoku.
name: 龍宴<EN>Ryuen
note:
<dPlnText:Spring water welling up in the holy land of the rising sun.
In appearance, it is nothing out of the ordinary.
　
The Yomi no Iwao are ancient remains.
They still dream of the banquet from long ago even now.>

description: 将軍家執政、左雨淡雪の手形。<EN>A permit from the Shogunke Regent, Sasame Awayuki.
name: 執政の印鑑<EN>Regent's Seal
note:
<dPlnText:A permit granted by the Regent
Proof of recognition as a dignitary
　
The greatest honor from Shikinowa,
and instances of it being granted to foreigners are extremely rare
　
Amira Aswad, the Queen of Ramla Aram and 「Goddess of Love」, is
one of the few who holds this honor>

description: 箱の中に納められた祭具。<EN>Ritual implements housed in a box.
name: 縁の盃<EN>Cup of Fate
note:
<dPlnText:An ancient ritual implement devised by the bloodline Given
to the people of Sesek It is connected to the threads of the
gods And opens the way to the Celestial Sanctuary, the
Panoramic Domain>

description: 旅の妖狸が持つお守り。<EN>A charm carried by a traveling Youri.
name: 妖狸小袋<EN>Youri Pouch
note:
<dPlnText:妖狸たちのお守り
四魂怪異、妖狸隠神の縁起物
　
その価値は、他の種族には理解できない><EN><dPlnText:A charm of the Youri
A lucky charm of the Shikon Kaii, Youri Inugami
　
Its value is incomprehensible to other races>

description: 落命ヶ浜の牢を封じるための鍵。<EN>A key used to seal the prison in Rakumeigahama
name: 涅塚の封じ<EN>Nezuka Seal
note:
<dPlnText:A seal that closes the impure mosquito net There, the monk
warps and touches the truth The Nenuka becomes the womb of
the Nue And the serpent becomes the omniscient infant>

description: 肉球の印影がある紙切れ。<EN>A scrap of paper with a paw-print mark.
name: 妖狸の手紙<EN>Yori's Letter
note:
<dPlnText:A letter only a Yori can read
Other races likely won't be able to understand it
　
The contents consist only of a paw print mark>

description: 石拾い道に埋められていた箱。<EN>A box buried along Ishihiroi Path.
name: 宝の箱<EN>Treasure Chest
note:
<dPlnText:A box buried in the ground It's fairly heavy. Seems like
something is inside Written large on the lid: Treasure>

description: 妖狸が持ち歩く箱。<EN>A box carried by a youri.
name: 妖狸箱<EN>Yori Box
note:
<dPlnText:A box belonging to a youri.
It has no lid and cannot be opened.
　
Though it is said to be filled with treasure,
generally, it is all nothing but tree leaves.>

description: 穢れているどんぐり。<EN>A tainted acorn.
name: 穢れどんぐり<EN>Tainted Acorn
note:
<dPlnText:A thoroughly defiled acorn No use for it can be found Even
the Yori would likely avoid it It's not worth a
single coin>

description: 命刻山でごく稀に見つかる鉱石。<EN>A mineral rarely found on Mount Meikoku.
name: 純粋な陽鉄<EN>Pure Yotetsu
note:
<dPlnText:A rare ore Rarely found in the holy land of the rising sun,
Mount Inochikoku It feels warm to the touch, exuding heat As
if it holds sunlight within>

description: 折れてしまった太刀。<EN>A broken tachi.
name: 折れた龍断ち<EN>Broken Dragon Slayer
note:
<dPlnText:A broken Dragon-Severer With heavy chipping, it cannot be
used as a weapon Originally a pair, the arms of the
Tabi-snake chief But one half was lost along with its arm>

description: 歴史館廃墟の竜人から手に入れた素材。<EN>Material obtained from the dragonkin in the ruins of the History Museum.
name: 火山の魔物の素材<EN>Volcanic Monster Material
note:
<dPlnText:Material obtained from a dragonkin A dull red scale This one
is not genuine But it's remarkably well-made and detailed
This is the very definition of putting the cart before the
horse>

description: アルワーフ砂漠で枯れていた花。<EN>A flower that had withered in the Alwaf Desert.
name: 枯れた砂漠の花<EN>Withered Desert Flower
note:
<dPlnText:A flower that blooms in the desert. It has withered away.
The Pure White flower is a gift from Retal. It leaves behind
the legend of the Roof bird.>

description: レタルで作られた真っ白な糸。<EN>Pure white thread made from Retal.
name: 真白糸<EN>Pure White Thread
note:
<dPlnText:A faintly glowing white thread. It remains, undefiled and
unrotted. Retal's thread is a bond of souls. It is fitting
as an invitation to the Third Layer.>

description: アスワドに咲く真白の花。<EN>A pure white flower that blooms in Aswad.
name: 砂漠の花<EN>Desert Flower
note:
<dPlnText:A flower that blooms in the desert. Everything is white,
like snow. Above the sleeping desert, the remains of Pure
White drift. There are two gravestones there. Dreaming, and
abandoning dreams. The world repeats that cycle.>

description: 比類なき者に贈られるもの。<EN>Something given to the peerless one.
name: 制覇のあかし<EN>Proof of Conquest
note:
<dPlnText:A medal given to the unparalleled. It is purely to honor great deeds, and
holds no further meaning.

The proof of conquest lies in the fact of having achieved it.>

description: 亜命がどこかで手に入れたもの。<EN>Something Amei acquired somewhere.
name: 長旅の土産<EN>Travel Souvenir
note:
<dPlnText:What Amei obtained. Souvenirs from an excessively long wandering journey.
The small monstrosity moved many times, and each time sought help.
Believing that someday it would reach its beloved friend. Only once, it
experienced something that made even grief forget. A small machine in the
decadent city of Zeenpolis. There, it had a modest place to belong.>

description: 刻印のもととなる無機質な石。<EN>A plain stone that serves as the base for a Seal.
name: 無地の刻印石<EN>Plain Engraving Stone
note:
<dPlnText:An eerily inorganic stone. It accepts power and becomes a
Seal. It can sometimes be found after fierce battles.>

description: 魂を編むという糸。<EN>A thread said to weave souls.
name: 神の糸<EN>Divine Thread
note:
<dPlnText:A relic of the ancient great monstrosity, Kamuy. It becomes a material that
produces Soul Ropes. In that great war, the Battle of Hazama Tsukahara, the
monstrosity brilliantly subjugated the army of the Hateful Roots. The
reason for that victory lay in the threads.>

description: 四魂を宿す葉。<EN>A leaf harboring the Shikon.
name: 四魂依り白葉<EN>Shikon-Vessel White Leaf
note:
<dPlnText:A relic of the ancient Great Kaii, Kanmui

description: 消えずに留まり残る魂の残滓。<EN>Lingering remnants of a soul that refuses to fade.
name: 魂の残滓<EN>Soul Residue
note:
<dPlnText:A soul left behind in that place. Though very faint, it
inherits the power it once had. Souls that have lost their
bodies drift aimlessly, eventually reaching the Yomi no
Iwao.>

description: 刻印の素材になる欠片。<EN>A fragment used as material for a Seal.
name: 虹色の欠片<EN>Rainbow Fragment
note:
<dPlnText:A fragment needed to turn a plain stone into a Seal. This is
a fragment of mana, a crystal of life force. If handled
correctly, one can utilize its power.>

description: かつて真白神社で用いられた神具。<EN>A sacred tool once used at Mashiro Shrine.
name: 神事熾し<EN>Sacred Fire
note:
<dPlnText:An ancient sacred tool of the Mashiro Shrine. A new power
dwells in the forge. The divine fire can turn even old iron
into a sword. The power of lost rites shall not fade.>

description: 離島より持ち込まれた古い種火。<EN>An old ember brought from a remote island.
name: セセクの種火<EN>Sesek's Ember
note:
<dPlnText:A kindling that was once in the treasure hall. A new power
dwells in the forge. The Sesek people excelled as craftsmen,
and their techniques aided the rites of souls.>

description: カンムイの血族に伝わる種火。<EN>An ember passed down among the bloodline of Kamuy.
name: 龍の種火<EN>Dragon Ember
note:
<dPlnText:One of the treasures of the Togimiya family. A new power dwells in the
forge. This is the primordial fire, the beginning of the rites of souls.
Only the forging rituals inherited by Mashiro shall recreate the sacred
artifacts of old.>

note:
<dPlnText:A soul left behind in that place. An extraordinary, special
one. The land of the Eastern Country is imbued with Kamuy's
power, which, along with mana, influences souls.>
